legal_sections: IPC 420 - Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
IT Act 66D - Cheating by personation using computer resource

investigation_steps.action: Immediately file transaction freeze request with the bank
investigation_steps.description: Contact the bank's nodal officer and request urgent freeze of the beneficiary account. RBI guidelines mandate action within 24-48 hours.

investigation_steps.action: Trace beneficiary account details and transaction trail
investigation_steps.description: Obtain full beneficiary account details, transaction hash/UTR, and follow the money trail through multiple accounts if layered.

investigation_steps.action: Collect digital evidence and screenshots
investigation_steps.description: Preserve call recordings, WhatsApp chats, SMS screenshots, phishing links, and any digital footprint left by the fraudster.

investigation_steps.action: Register FIR under applicable sections
investigation_steps.description: File First Information Report at the cyber crime police station. Include all transaction details, amount, and evidence.

investigation_steps.action: Initiate fund reversal process through bank
investigation_steps.description: Coordinate with bank's nodal officer to reverse the fraudulent transaction. Submit formal request with FIR copy.

investigation_steps.action: Update complainant on case progress
investigation_steps.description: Inform the victim about freeze status, FIR registration, and expected timeline for fund recovery.

financial_fraud.sample_freezing_letter: To, The Nodal Officer, [Bank Name], [Branch Address]. Subject: Urgent Freeze Request under Section [xx] of IT Act, 2000. This is to bring to your kind notice that a cyber financial fraud of Rs. [Amount] has been reported vide Complaint No. [Complaint ID] dated [Date]. The fraudulent transaction details are: Transaction ID: [Txn ID], Amount: [Amount], Beneficiary Account: [Acc No]. You are requested to immediately freeze the beneficiary account and hold the transaction for further investigation. This request is made as per RBI guidelines on time-bound action against cyber frauds. Thanking you, [Signature], [Rank], [Police Station].

legal_sections: IT Act 66D - Cheating by personation using computer resource

investigation_steps.action: Verify caller identity through call detail records (CDR)
investigation_steps.description: Immediately request CDR from telecom provider to trace the caller's location, IMEI number, and call flow.

investigation_steps.action: Warn complainant not to pay any further amount
investigation_steps.description: Contact the victim immediately and inform them that no government agency demands money over phone/video call. Provide counseling.

investigation_steps.action: Trace IP address and digital footprints from video call platform
investigation_steps.description: Request WhatsApp/Zoom/Google Meet logs to trace the caller's IP address and device information.

investigation_steps.action: Check for similar complaints in district and state
investigation_steps.description: Cross-reference with existing complaints using same phone number, UPI ID, or modus operandi to identify syndicate.

investigation_steps.action: Issue public awareness alert through official channels
investigation_steps.description: Publish warning on social media, police website, and WhatsApp broadcast about the new scam modus operandi.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with banks to freeze any transferred amounts
investigation_steps.description: If victim has transferred money, follow financial fraud SOP to freeze beneficiary accounts.

digital_arrest.victim_counseling_script: Sir/Madam, please understand that no government agency including CBI, ED, Income Tax, or Police ever conducts 'digital arrest' or demands money for case closure over phone or video call. This is a scam. Please disconnect immediately. Never share OTP, never install any app, never transfer money. If you have already lost money, please visit your nearest cyber cell with transaction details.

fake_news.priority: HIGH (if communal or law & order impact)
legal_sections: IPC 505 - False news with intent to cause fear
IT Act 66A - Offensive messages (advisory - as per SC ruling)
IPC 505(1)(b) - False news with intent to cause public mischief

investigation_steps.action: Identify original source of the message
investigation_steps.description: Trace the message back to its origin by analyzing forward chains, metadata, and sender details.

investigation_steps.action: Conduct fact-checking through official sources
investigation_steps.description: Verify the claim through PIB Fact Check, government websites, or contacting relevant authorities.

investigation_steps.action: Issue official clarification through all channels
investigation_steps.description: Publish fact-check result on police website, social media, and press release. Issue WhatsApp broadcast if needed.

investigation_steps.action: Track spread of misinformation on social media
investigation_steps.description: Monitor Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and WhatsApp groups for continued spread. Identify key sharers.

investigation_steps.action: Register case under relevant sections
investigation_steps.description: If false news has caused actual harm (panic, violence, loss), register FIR under applicable sections.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with platform owners to remove content
investigation_steps.description: Send legal request to WhatsApp/Facebook/Twitter to remove the fake message and identify repeat offenders.

fake_news.public_warning_template: ⚠️ ALERT! A message is circulating on WhatsApp/Social Media claiming that [content of fake message]. This claim is FALSE. Please do not forward this message. Official source confirms that [fact-check result]. For any clarification, contact your nearest police station or call 1930. - Uttar Pradesh Police

legal_sections: IT Act 66F - Cyber terrorism (if national security threat)
NDPS Act - Narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances

investigation_steps.action: ESCALATE TO SPECIALIZED CYBER CRIME CELL
investigation_steps.description: Darknet cases require specialized forensic tools and expertise. Immediately escalate to state/national cyber crime unit.

investigation_steps.action: Preserve ALL digital evidence
investigation_steps.description: Secure screenshots, onion links, PGP keys, Bitcoin addresses, wallet transactions, and communication logs.

investigation_steps.action: Trace cryptocurrency transactions
investigation_steps.description: Use blockchain forensic tools (like Chainalysis) to trace Bitcoin/Monero transactions and identify wallets.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with CERT-In for technical investigation
investigation_steps.description: CERT-In has specialized capabilities for darknet investigation, IP tracing through Tor exit nodes.

investigation_steps.action: Initiate parallel financial investigation
investigation_steps.description: Trace any cryptocurrency to exchange accounts; coordinate with FIU-IND for money trail.

investigation_steps.action: Register FIR under appropriate sections
investigation_steps.description: Based on type of illegal activity (drugs/weapons/data/hacking), register FIR under NDPS/Arms/IT Act.

investigation_steps.action: Maintain strict secrecy of investigation
investigation_steps.description: Darknet investigations are highly sensitive. Limit information sharing on a need-to-know basis.

darknet.special_notes: Darknet investigations require specialized training and tools. Many darknet markets operate internationally. Coordinate with INTERPOL if the crime involves cross-border elements. Never attempt to access darknet links from police network without proper safeguards.

identity_theft.priority: HIGH (if financial loss or reputational harm)
legal_sections: IPC 468 - Forgery for purpose of cheating
IPC 471 - Using forged document as genuine

investigation_steps.action: Freeze Aadhaar through UIDAI portal
investigation_steps.description: Immediately lock biometric authentication on UIDAI portal. Request temporary deactivation if needed.

investigation_steps.action: Block PAN card through income tax portal
investigation_steps.description: Report unauthorized use of PAN to Income Tax Department. Request blocking or reissuance of PAN.

investigation_steps.action: Check for unauthorized financial transactions/loans
investigation_steps.description: Request CIBIL report to check if loans or credit cards have been opened using victim's identity.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with banks/platforms to freeze/fake accounts
investigation_steps.description: Send legal request to Facebook/Instagram/Twitter/Banks to take down fake profiles/accounts.

investigation_steps.action: Collect evidence of impersonation
investigation_steps.description: Gather screenshots of fake profile, messages sent to contacts, and any financial transactions done using stolen identity.

investigation_steps.action: Register FIR under IT Act 66C and IPC sections
investigation_steps.description: File FIR documenting all aspects of identity theft and any resulting financial/reputational damage.

investigation_steps.action: Issue public clarification if reputation affected
investigation_steps.description: If needed, issue statement through police channels clarifying that victim's identity was stolen.

identity_theft.victim_guidance: 1. Immediately change passwords of all email and social media accounts. 2. Enable two-factor authentication everywhere. 3. Freeze your Aadhaar biometrics on UIDAI portal. 4. Download CIBIL report to check for unauthorized credit activity. 5. Report fake profiles to platform using 'impersonation' option. 6. File police complaint with all evidence.

legal_sections: IPC 507 - Criminal intimidation by anonymous communication

investigation_steps.action: Trace caller/message origin through CDR and IP logs
investigation_steps.description: Request call detail records from telecom provider. For social media, request IP logs from platform.

investigation_steps.action: Issue warning to perpetrator
investigation_steps.description: Once identified, issue official warning through police notice or summon for counseling.

investigation_steps.action: Provide psychological counseling to victim
investigation_steps.description: Connect victim with police counselor or NGO for mental health support.

investigation_steps.action: Arrest if threats continue
investigation_steps.description: If perpetrator continues stalking after warning, arrest under IPC 354D and produce before magistrate.

investigation_steps.action: IMMEDIATELY warn victim not to pay any money
investigation_steps.description: Contact victim immediately. Paying encourages more demands. Do NOT share any more images or money.

investigation_steps.action: Preserve all digital evidence
investigation_steps.description: Secure screenshots of chats, video call screenshots, blackmail messages, payment demands, social media profiles.

investigation_steps.action: Trace IP and account details of blackmailer
investigation_steps.description: Request platform (WhatsApp/Instagram/Telegram) to provide IP logs and account creation details.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with platform to block content
investigation_steps.description: If content already shared, send legal notice to platform to remove all copies.

investigation_steps.action: Register immediate FIR
investigation_steps.description: File FIR under IT Act 66E, 67 and IPC 354C, 384. Mention urgency and threat of content going viral.

investigation_steps.action: Provide victim counseling
investigation_steps.description: Victim may feel shame or guilt. Provide reassurance that they are not at fault. Connect to mental health support.

investigation_steps.action: Trace payment and beneficiary details
investigation_steps.description: Follow money trail using transaction ID/UPT. Identify beneficiary account.

investigation_steps.action: Identify fake company/HR details
investigation_steps.description: Search for similar complaints using same company name, phone number, or website.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with banks for freeze
investigation_steps.description: Request freeze of beneficiary account if amount is significant.

investigation_steps.action: Register FIR under IPC 420
investigation_steps.description: File case documenting the fake job offer and financial loss.

loan_app_fraud.category_name: Loan App Fraud / Digital Lending Scam

investigation_steps.action: IMMEDIATELY request Google/Apple to remove the app
investigation_steps.description: Send legal request to Google Play Store / Apple App Store to take down the fraudulent loan app.

investigation_steps.action: Trace app developer and bank account
investigation_steps.description: Identify developer details from app listing and trace linked bank account for loan disbursement.

investigation_steps.action: Coordinate with banks to freeze accounts
investigation_steps.description: Freeze both loan disbursement account and EMI collection accounts.

investigation_steps.action: Issue public warning about app
investigation_steps.description: Publish warning about the specific loan app on police social media and website.

investigation_steps.action: Register FIR under relevant sections
investigation_steps.description: Include privacy violation, extortion, and obscene content sharing in FIR.

investigation_steps.action: Register complaint in NCRP portal
investigation_steps.description: Ensure complaint is registered in National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.

investigation_steps.action: Collect all digital evidence
investigation_steps.description: Preserve all screenshots, call logs, messages, transaction proofs.

investigation_steps.action: Classify crime type and assign investigating officer
investigation_steps.description: Based on AI classification, assign appropriate IO with relevant expertise.

investigation_steps.action: Initiate investigation as per category SOP
investigation_steps.description: Follow category-specific SOP from this document.
